title: Turning Multi-Agent Communication into Token-Level Credit with On Policy Self Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning improves problem solving in large language model multi-agent systems. Existing approaches overlook communication knowledge or compress it into scalar rewards, leaving coarse credit with little guidance on which decisions each agent should reinforce or revise. OPSD4MAS converts future communication into fine-grained token-level credit through On Policy Self Distillation (OPSD). An external model extracts facts and assesses their trajectory relations for coarse-grained filtering, followed by fine-grained leave-one-out filtering of target-token influence against agent-wise outcome advantages. The fact-conditioned policy supplies token-level credit, combined with GRPO through a linearly annealed joint objective. Our method improves mathematical pass@4 over GRPO by up to 20.00 percentage points. Ablations support complete filtering, while frozen-history injection diagnostics support fact utility. translated_title: 基于在线策略自蒸馏将多智能体通信转化为词元级信用分配
translated_abstract: 强化学习可以提升大语言模型多智能体系统的问题求解能力。然而，现有方法往往忽略通信知识，或将其压缩为标量奖励，导致信用分配过于粗糙，无法为每个智能体应强化或修正哪些决策提供有效指导。OPSD4MAS 通过在线策略自蒸馏将未来通信转化为细粒度的词元级信用。该方法首先由外部模型提取事实并评估其与轨迹的关系，进行粗粒度过滤，随后针对智能体层面的结果优势，对目标词元的影响进行细粒度的留一法过滤。事实条件化策略提供词元级信用，并通过线性退火的联合目标与 GRPO 相结合。我们的方法在数学任务的 pass@4 指标上相比 GRPO 提升高达 20 个百分点。消融实验验证了完整过滤机制的必要性，而冻结历史注入诊断实验则支持了事实信息的有效性。综上，这些结果表明该方法能够有效实现多智能体系统中的细粒度信用分配。
tldr: 该论文提出 OPSD4MAS 方法，通过在线策略自蒸馏将多智能体通信内容转化为细粒度的词元级信用信号，并与 GRPO 结合训练，使数学任务 pass@4 相比基线最高提升 20 个百分点。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OPSD4MAS, which converts multi-agent communication into fine-grained token-level credit via On-Policy Self Distillation combined with GRPO, improving mathematical pass@4 by up to 20 percentage points over the baseline.
